outcome_branch: early rejection at performance-leadership.md section 6 step 2: per-round JoinSet spawn is below 1% of nb-fetch-multinode CPU; remaining implementation criteria do not apply
hypothesis: Each multi-leader fetch spawns one JoinSet task per leader. Replacing that with long-lived fetchers would cut CPU-ns/record on nb-fetch-multinode.
finding: One parent run did 1 round, 3 fetch requests, fetched 399000 records, and used 131.929 ms of client CPU (6596 ns/record) and 289865 allocations. A current-thread JoinSet of three immediate tasks measured 1020 ns per round, 0.0008% of that CPU. A 100x allowance for moving the real fetch future is still under 0.1%. Removing three task allocations would be about 0.001% of the round. Wall time was 0.351 s with fast-node records/s 56973; the 50 ms slow leader dominates the non-CPU gap and is outside this card. No production code was changed.
